  ! This let declares a variable that is only assigned once.
  
  > 1 │ let count = 1;
      │ ^^^
    2 │ export const view = count;
    3 │ 
  
  i 'count' is never reassigned.
  
  > 1 │ let count = 1;
      │     ^^^^^
    2 │ export const view = count;
    3 │ 
  
  i Safe fix: Use const instead.
  
    1   │ - let·count·=·1;
      1 │ + const·count·=·1;
    2 2 │   export const view = count;
    3 3 │
